units.source_text: 匂亲王在归途上只管回想二女公子惜别伤离的娇容，竟想不顾体统，中途折回。

en.t: On the way home, Prince Niou could think only of the lovely sight of the two young ladies grieving at their parting, and he even wanted to turn back midway, heedless of propriety.

units.source_text: 然而恐被世人讥评，只得忍痛返京。

en.t: But fearing that people would criticize him, he had no choice but to bear the pain and return to the capital.

units.source_text: 今后欲再度偷访，很不容易了。

en.t: From now on, it would be very difficult for him to visit secretly again.

units.source_text: 他回京之后，每日写信送往宇治，源源不绝。

en.t: After he returned to the capital, he wrote letters every day and sent them to Uji without interruption.

units.source_text: 宇治的人由此推想他的爱情是真挚的。

en.t: Because of this, the people at Uji concluded that his love was sincere.

units.source_text: 然而久不来访，大女公子不免忧愁起来，

en.t: Yet when he did not come to visit for a long time, the elder young lady could not help growing anxious,

units.source_text: 她想：“我自己虽然决心不植这种愁根，却比自己的事更感痛苦。”

en.t: and she thought, "Although I myself have resolved not to plant such a root of sorrow, this pains me even more than if it were my own affair."

units.source_text: 但她知道妹妹本人一定更加悲伤，所以表面上装作若无其事，只是独身之志益坚，

en.t: But she knew that her younger sister herself must be still more sorrowful, so outwardly she pretended that nothing was wrong, while her resolve to remain unmarried only grew stronger,

units.source_text: 她想：“至少我自己不要遭受这种苦患。”

en.t: and she thought, "At least I myself must not suffer such misery."
